title: Design System: Pit Crew owner desk

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Native button press feedback; removed when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Explicit owner action submitted by a native form.

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Secondary action using the shared surface and separator.

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Native field with a visible label and strengthened boundary.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-note">Audit note</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-note" type="text">

components.name: Owner navigation
components.description: Current-page navigation wraps above the content on narrower screens.
components.html: Help-desk queueFix jobs
components.css: .ds-nav{padding:1.25rem .75rem;border-right:1px solid var(--line);font:1rem/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{display:block;padding:.7rem .75rem;min-height:44px;border-radius:.35rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted)}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);font-weight:700}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--surface)}@media(max-width:60rem){.ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.25rem;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:.75rem}.ds-nav a{padding:.6rem .75rem}}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-input:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-details summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Notice
components.description: Flat evidence or action explanation with a visible boundary.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.description: Native details exposes wrapped, scrollable saved evidence.
components.css: .ds-details{margin:.5rem 0;font:1rem/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text)}.ds-details summary{min-height:44px;padding:.55rem 0;cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent)}.ds-evidence{margin:.5rem 0 1rem;padding:.8rem;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font:.85rem/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace;max-height:32rem;overflow:auto}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-input:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-details summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px;}
